contracts.scene-artifact-envelope: A theorem-artifact part with artifactKind "scene" carries, as its payload, exactly the theorem-scene-v1 payload a theorem-scene part carries (contractVersion, sceneId, title, fallbackText, packageHash, scenePackage). The UI reads it as the same scene; a theorem-scene part with the same packageHash beside it is not listed twice.
contracts.frame-contract-mount-options: mountRenderers(table, { bare, fills }): a bare renderer draws the whole reply surface (no card); a renderer that fills takes the whole panel body.
contracts.scene-frame-continuity: Host to page: sceneos:mount may carry checkpoint; sceneos:theme {theme} repaints without remounting; sceneos:poster-request asks for a still. Page to host: sceneos:mounted may carry restore ('restored'|'none'|'stale'|'incompatible', its presence means the page keeps checkpoints); sceneos:state {checkpoint: {version:int, packageDigest, ...}} after each change; sceneos:poster {image: data:image/(webp|png|jpeg) under 1 MB}.
